strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Grendizer is destroyed
It's almost time. We'll intercept the Vega Star Federation.
Captain, we'd best sortie and deploy in advance.
Right, all hands, sortie!
The Vega Star Federation, back again... Ngh...!
Daisuke? Are you all right?
Hmm? Haven't you been pushing yourself a bit hard lately?
D-Don't worry... I just felt a little dizzy...
(Brother... Could it be... the Vegatron radiation...!?)
By the way, is this lunar city really such an important place?
It is. As a supply base, it's in a very important location.
In battle, a secure supply line is a unit's lifeline, after all.
Having a base or not makes a huge difference to the budget...
Good thing we got here ahead of the enemy.
...Still, I just don't get what they're after.
Huh? What do you mean, Brother?
They're just like the other invaders, right? Their aim's obvious.
What's bothering you, Daisuke?
Daisuke, aren't you overthinking this?
What's on your mind?
...Well... they seem awfully fixated on the area around the Moon.
Weren't they after invading Earth?
Hmm, now that you mention it, I got jumped right after leaving Anaheim.
Is there somethin' here?
Anaheim Electronics, Von Braun here...
plus a few resource mining bases... There are facilities, sure...
Don't tell me they're attacking 'cause it's closer than Earth.
This is no time for dumb jokes, Shinobu. Here they come!
Enter the enemy~
There they are. Everyone, you ready!?
Bring it on, anytime!
Oho! You move quickly, Earthlings!
So that's Grendizer... If I defeat it...
Yes. Unless you defeat it, the Freeze Ray research
you inherited from your late brother will be handed to someone else!
I won't let that happen!
I'll defeat Duke Fleed... and carry on my brother's research!
Yes, and that's why I've entrusted you with our trump card...
Lure him out skillfully.
That emblem...! So you've shown up, King Vega's Royal Guard!
Duke Fleed!
I can't stand you lording it over space like you're its king!
Hah! Big talk from a bunch who act like they own the place!
We'll send you packing.
Whatever the reason, I show invaders no mercy...!
(Yes, even if the Vegatron radiation burns out my life...!!)
Now I'll wipe you from this universe...! Attack!
Here I go! Grendizer, GO!
Kyaa! ...Earthlings... I'm no match for them... But!
Hm!? An escape Minifo? You won't get away!
Wait, Duke Fleed! Are you sure you want to shoot me down?
A woman...!?
Tch! Don't you dare beg for your life!
Either fight or tuck your tail and run, pick one!
What do you mean!?
I have a Minus Vegatron gun that neutralizes Vegatron radiation.
Brother!? With that... you could be...!
Hey, what's going on, Maria!? Vegatron radiation...
Daisuke, don't tell me...!?
Vegatron radiation...!? Daisuke, could it be that you...!?
If you want this, trade me Grendizer for it!
What!? ...That's dirty!
Say what you like... I have something I must do,
and that means defeating Grendizer!
Now, Duke Fleed, if you want the Minus Vegatron gun,
follow me!
Wait!
Don't go after her, Maria!
Brother...!?
...Vegatron radiation... Search data from Omoikane.
It's the radiation given off by decaying Vegatron ore.
...It's harmful to humans.
Don't tell me... Duke's body is...!?
You've been hiding this...!?
But! With a Minus Vegatron ray...!
No, Maria...! I can't abandon the friends fighting alongside us!
The enemy in front of us comes before me...!
No! Daisuke!
That's right, Duke Fleed! If you fight like this...
you're just a burden!
Koji...!
...Sick people should stay out of the way.
T-Tetsuya!?
Someone in your shape hanging around in front of me is a distraction.
How can you say that...!
So, Daisuke, hurry up and get well... and come straight back.
Until the King of Space returns... the Brave Mazinger will hold the fort...!
Tetsuya...!
Looks like the answer's clear, no? ...Go on, Duke Fleed.
Captain Bright, Captain Misumaru... I...
...Grendizer is assigned to pursue the fleeing enemy craft.
Refusal is not permitted. ...That's an order.
Well then. ...Ruri?
Right. ...The enemy from before is flying toward Earth.
Sending estimated arrival time and entry point to Grendizer.
I'm sorry... I'm sorry, everyone! I'll come back, I swear I will...!
Brother!
I'll call this a good result. Duke Fleed is gone!
Now I'll finish you lot off here!
I don't like their methods.
...I won't forgive this...!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hmph, these fools... not bad at all! Interesting! We'll settle this later!
What!? Ah!
Aww, come on! It got away!
Get back here! You're not getting away!
Coward...!
Stop, don't pursue! Never underestimate the Royal Guard!
Tch! I'll pound that wimpy bastard flat!
Let's chase him down and settle this!
Fujiwara, we can't leave this place right now...
When the time comes, we'll settle things for sure...!
Shinobu! Umon's right. Getting stranded again would be ridiculous!
Fujiwara, Daisuke's right, y'know?
Duke Fleed has the right idea. We'll settle it eventually...!
Must be tough for my brother. He's got so many names.
...Tch, this sucks.
Good, we've driven off the Vega Star Federation's main force. Mop up!
All right, one more push! Let's give it everything!
I thought the Royal Guard would be cooler guys...
They're a bit much, huh?
Heh heh... You seem to be in quite a state, Londo Bell!
That's... Neo Zeon!? Blast it, at a time like this...!
Neo Zeon mobile suit unit confirmed.
Their objective doesn't seem to be intercepting the Vega forces.
You mean, they're...
We're the target, huh...
Hm? ...Heh, this is a golden opportunity.
Right, ignore the Earth army that just arrived!
Our target is Duke Fleed! And his comrades!
Captain! What do we do!?
...There's nothing to decide...! We can't fall back!
Heh, that's right! It's no big deal!
We crush them all... That's all there is to it...!
Mashymre Cello...! Mashymre! Stop it!
There's no need for a pointless fight!
You're... Judau, Judau Ashta! Heh heh... Interesting!
This will make a fine tale for Lady Haman!
Seems like... they're not even having the same conversation.
Read the situation! You pompous creep!
Rant all you like! My loyalty to Lady Haman will not waver!
He's not listening at all...
...Haman, is it?
We're all human...!
Now we'll just have to go all-out! I've had it!
That's right! It's fine, isn't it, Bright?
...I told you we can't fall back!
Take them out one by one. Defend Von Braun at all costs!
We'll intercept the Vega forces and hold off Neo Zeon too!
Aestivalis team, please stay flexible!
Flexible, she says. Easy for her to say!
You say I underestimated you!?
Blast it, remember this! I swear on Lady Haman's rose, I will...!
Neo Zeon's Haman Karn...! Hmph.
Can't you see the state of the Earth Sphere,
and that this is no time for us to fight each other!?
Irrelevant! To us Spacenoids, the Federation squatting on Earth is evil!
The aliens are welcome to that planet!
This guy's talking total nonsense...
We love our homes too... That's no different for us!
What fools! You don't even know why I came here!
The reason... he came here!?
I don't care what it is! Mashymre!
Tell Haman this! Hatred only breeds more hatred.
If she still spreads hatred through space... I won't forgive her!
Don't lecture me as if you know, boy...!
Hatred breeds hatred. ...That's true...
...Judau, right now we must deal with the problem in front of us.
...I know... I know that... Quattro...!
Whew, I wondered how that'd turn out... Looks like we wiped them out.
Right. ...Now it's up to Daisuke and Maria.
What a messy hassle, but it seems to be over for now.
I wonder if Daisuke and Maria caught up...
Grendizer should be fine, but... what about our fighting strength?
Losing Grendizer hurts, but our own forces are growing stronger.
Heh heh~ Leave it to me! Rely on me all you like!
He probably means the Cyber Beast Force or the Dangaioh team.
That's one way to see it.
Well, Commander Hazuki's in for a shock when Grendizer shows up.
He'll be less trouble than we are, so it'll be fine.
Still... for the Royal Guard, that Vega attack earlier
was awfully half-hearted...
Maybe it was to lure us out... no, to lure Umon out?
Oh, like Gil does?
He's a stubborn one, too.
In that case, Zeon's movements concern me too.
For an attack exploiting the chaos, as Dr. Inez said,
it was far too careless.
Captain, so you think their real aim lies elsewhere?
...Most likely.
But with things like the missing transport colony,
there's been one fishy incident after another...
...Mashymre... if Mashymre Cello moved in person,
I think it's because Haman gave some kind of order.
And who's that?
...A bad woman from Zeon. If it really was her order...
I won't let her get away with some whim like that.
Aren't you overthinking it?
Yeah, yeah. We've just gotta crush 'em one at a time.
We'll just have to stay positive.
Right, we'll resupply in Von Braun City and head for the next point.
All units, return to ship.
King Vega's goal is invading Earth, yet he's fixated on the Moon...
I wonder if there's something there. I'd like an explanation.
